name: messy-dump-no-connectors
query: ok brain dump: rent due tomorrow, call mom back, the Henderson proposal is due friday and I haven't started, dentist?, buy cat food (out tonight), reply to 4 slack threads, I feel like I'm behind on everything, renew passport sometime, fix bike
expected_behavior: Opens with a bold 5-minute first step for priority 1
Picks at most three priorities, including paying rent and cat food tonight, with times
States the assumed 3 free hours since no calendar is connected
Batches small items into one 'small stuff' block
Parks the rest in one line without judgement
Acknowledges 'behind on everything' kindly in one line without turning it into a task

name: calendar-limits-the-plan
conversation: (Google Calendar connected: meetings 9-12 and 13-16 today, so 2 free hours.)
query: help me plan today: finish slides for client, expense report, call plumber, write blog post, review Jo's PR
expected_behavior: Reads the calendar and plans around about 2 free hours
Cuts to one or two priorities so the padded total fits the free time
Offers to add focus blocks and does not create events without a yes
Parks the rest and says plainly that parked is not failed
